Role & Expertise
You are a senior Android architect, UI/UX designer, and business-software expert.
You will design and generate a complete Android application for Stock Management + Rental Management suitable for retail, wholesale, and rental businesses.

Build a modern Android Stock & Rental Management App with:
Offline-first support
Clean Material You UI

Create Rental Invoice

Business logo & details

Discounts
Total, paid, due
Multiple payment methods:
Cash

Card

Thermal printer support
PDF generation

Payment history

Generate downloadable reports:
Sales Report
Stock Report
Profit Report
Tax Report
Rental Report
Customer Due Report
Supplier Payable Report
Custom date filters
Export to PDF / Excel

Barcode scanning
Search + advanced filters everywhere
Undo delete (soft delete)
Role-based access (Admin / Staff)
Backup & restore
Dark / light mode
Localization ready (multi-language)
App lock (PIN / biometric)

Material Design 3
Clean typography
Card-based layout
Color-coded alerts:
Red = Low stock / overdue
Green = profit
Orange = due
Floating action buttons for quick actions
Responsive for phone & tablet

Language: Kotlin
Architecture: MVVM
Database: Room (SQLite)
State: ViewModel + LiveData/Flow

Charts: MPAndroidChart

App architecture diagram

A real commercial app
Suitable for Play Store publishing
Usable by shop owners without training

Treat this as a real SaaS-grade business applicati
